messages:
Mira Chen: FYI opened PR to split auth/tf-mod into tf-mod-auth + tf-mod-creds and pin provider versions. Need a quick sanity + secretpath handoff check before I regen lockfile. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4823
Daniel Park: pinged. quick Q: how are you mapping k8s secrets -> Terraform secret path? trying to understand migration impact for apps in staging.
Mira Chen: current plan is to keep k8s secrets as-is, add a new terraform resource that writes to secrets manager under new path `infra/tf/creds/<env>/<service>`, and update helm values to read from that path. will include mapping table in PR description.
Ryan O'Neill: provider pin details? major bump? any breaking provider changes we need to gate (eg. aws 3.x -> 4.x style)?
Mira Chen: pinning aws provider to 3.75.0 for now to avoid drift. not upgrading to 4.x yet. also pinning kubernetes provider to 2.11.0. leaving notes in providers.tf: ```provider "aws" { version = "~> 3.75.0" } provider "kubernetes" { version = "~> 2.11.0" }```
infra-bot: CI check failed — `terraform init` detected lockfile mismatch. See https://ci.internal/redwood/infra/4823/build/12 for logs.
Daniel Park: ok lockfile regen expected. can you include `scripts/regen-lockfile.sh` in the PR and a note on how to run locally? small teams will need that.
Mira Chen: added script and local steps in PR. local command: `./scripts/regen-lockfile.sh --workspace=staging` (this runs `terraform providers lock` then updates).
Ryan O'Neill: about state moves — are you doing `terraform state mv` for the secret resources? that can be noisy across modules. consider provider_alias or wrapper module to keep old addresses working during rollout.
Mira Chen: good call. plan A: state mv for the few services that own secrets (manual, low volume). Plan B: compatibility wrapper module for others if we see more. will include a canary list.
Lexi (oncall): I can run a staging canary tonight. need the exact steps + a rollback plan. can you paste the state mv commands and helm values patch I'll need?
Mira Chen: sure — example state mv command: `terraform state mv module.old_auth.module.secret.aws_secretsmanager_secret.main module.tf_mod_creds.aws_secretsmanager_secret.creds` and helm patch snippet: `extra.env.SECRET_PATH: "infra/tf/creds/staging/service-a"`. Rollback is `terraform state mv` back to original address and restore helm values from git.
Ryan O'Neill: also document required RBAC for the new secret paths (who can read/write). otherwise owners will hit permission denied during canary.
Mira Chen: added RBAC bullets to PR and a link to IAM role: `infra-roles/terraform-secrets-writer`.
Daniel Park: looks reasonable. small nit: add a comment in providers.tf explaining why pins are conservative and when to revisit (quarterly). helps future PRs.
Mira Chen: done. added comment and TODO ticket #6174 to track upgrade to kubernetes provider 3.x later.
Lexi (oncall): I'll run the staging canary at 23:00 PST, will DM if anything flaky. if green, we can schedule a production window tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Mira Chen: awesome, thanks! tagging @ryan for a quick review of the state mv vs wrapper approach when you have 20m.
Ryan O'Neill: will take a look in ~30. if no surprises I'll :shipit:
